Companion Type — Third-party notices / 第三方组件说明

Windows x86_64 Companion Type: exact locked normal Cargo input closure and observed rendered frontend modules. This is a conservative attribution inventory, not a claim every dependency symbol is in the executable. Proc macros/build-only and other-target packages are excluded. Windows/WebView2 system runtime and unbundled optional speech models are not claimed as bundled components. Denzic-owned local crates retain their existing ownership; no new license is assigned.
